findings.reason: on the only route from an IDS read to the measure the values are untranslated, so the table would be measured in COCOS 11 and reported as COCOS 17; the section must name the reader that feeds it, or take the dependency on the reader node for the node to produce the evidence it promises.
findings.text: the node is asked to report the measure for DINA 105052/1, 105069/3, CORSICA 130506/6 "in COCOS 17 after translation", but §5 names no reader that supplies these rows, and the only production caller of the measure today is the MAST parity chain: `grep -rln edge_consistency nova tests scripts` returns `nova/imas/edge_consistency.py`, `nova/imas/mast_parity_chain.py` and `tests/test_edge_consistency.py` only, and `nova/imas/equilibrium.py` and `nova/imas/getslice.py` (the readers that supply an IDS equilibrium slice) contain no call to `translate_equilibrium` — they still pass raw IDS values and are deferred to the open followup f-ddc-002

findings.reason: as written the §5 node would settle the §6 reference on numbers the plan's own decision says are dominated by the unfixed sign, and f-ddc-007 would then overturn the verdict; §5's done-when (3) needs to gate on the sign fix (or state the sign-corrected reading) to close on a verdict that survives.
findings.text: done-when (3) asks the node to confirm or revise the iter-passive-plasma-circuit §6 reference on its table, but decision `d-ddc-flux-function-sign` (recorded the same day as this plan version) states that on exactly these three conforming sources, read through the translator, nova's flux functions put the profile current anti-parallel to the map current (slope −0.96, correlation −0.99), and followups f-ddc-005/006/007 place the fix at `nova/equilibrium/convention.py`'s owner as a §4 node with the table to be re-measured afterwards — yet §5 declares `depends-on` only `dd-cocos-ingest#s1` and `dd-cocos-ingest#s2` and its body mentions the sign defect nowhere

findings.reason: the mechanism §5 relies on (measure the edge residual with the repository's one structured-grid operator and factor) is unaffected; only the description of the base state is stale, and correcting it changes no node's work.
findings.text: the body states that `nova/imas/mast_parity_chain.py::_profile_reproduction_residuals` "assembles Δ* inline by central differences over the plasma flux and recovers the current density as −Δ*/(TOTAL_FLUX_FACTOR μ0 R)" and that "§5's algebra stays consistent with that inline operator", but the landed code no longer assembles it inline: `_interior_grid_current_density` pads the map by one ring and calls `grid_current_density` (mast_parity_chain.py:396–422), which delegates to `nova/equilibrium/map_extraction.apply_delta_star` — the same operator §5's own module docstring names
